To reduce the burden on ACDE calls I have made a Ethereum Magicians post for EIPs 7932 and 7980 inclusion for async review: [The case for EIP-7932 & EIP-7980 inclusion in Glamsterdam](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/the-case-for-eip-7932-eip-7980-inclusion-in-glamsterdam/25293).

Edit: I won't be able to be on the ACDE calls due to when they run. If anyone has any questions, I'll be happy to answer them on the magicians post.

I would like to briefly talk about [EIP-7976 ](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7976)and [EIP-7981](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7981).

**EIP-7976: Increase Calldata Floor Cost** 
Increases the calldata floor cost from 10/40 to 15/60 gas per zero/non-zero byte for data-heavy transactions, reducing the maximum block size by ~33% (from 1.07MB to 0.72MB). Regular users (doing DeFi and token transfers) remain unaffected as transactions with significant EVM computation continue to pay standard rates (4/16 gas), while data-heavy payloads face higher costs to create headroom for future gas limit increases. **As of today, only 1.5% of transactions would have been affected - for a 33% decrease in worst-case block size.** 

**EIP-7981: Increase Access List Cost**
Closes a loophole where access lists bypass EIP-7623's floor pricing by adding calldata pricing to access list data on top of existing storage costs. This prevents transactions from achieving maximum block size by combining access lists with calldata, reducing worst-case block size by ~21% and effectively deprecating access lists for gas optimization while maintaining backward compatibility.

I would like to briefly talk about [EIP-2780](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2780)

**EIP-2780: Reduce intrinsic transaction gas**

Reduce the intrinsic cost `TX_BASE_COST` from `21,000` to `6,000`.
If a non-create transaction has `value > 0` and targets a non-existent account add `GAS_NEW_ACCOUNT = 25,000` to align with `CALL` account creation and price in state growth.

Capacity Impact:
- Average: +18.5% more transactions per block.
- Max: +250% more minimal transactions (i.e. pure ETH transfers).
- “Equivalent” gaslimit: +18.5% effectual gaslimit increase (e.g. 45 M => 53.3 M); though nominally would remain the same.

The STEEL team wants to announce The Weld of the [ethereum/execution-specs](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs) and [ethereum/execution-spec-tests](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests) repositories.

More details in this link: https://steel.ethereum.foundation/blog/blog_posts/2025-09-11_weld-announcement/
